workflow_scale_routing.rationale: One written artifact can hold the movement through text sections without long-work stewardship.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

writing_method.rationale: The output is a reader-facing article whose opening promise, reveal, and payoff need deliberate shape rather than raw fragments.

medium_output_shape_recommendation.rationale: The Beat Plan already has a concrete curiosity hook, a civic reveal, and a perceptual payoff, so a broad article form with a specific Cultural Format Structure is the clearest fit.
tradeoffs: The article form gives room for a true turn and payoff without forcing an artist-statement speaker.
A social post would sharpen the hook but compress the middle labor reveal too far.
A reported feature would imply interviews and factual sourcing that this safe invented rehearsal does not have.

cultural_format_structure.name: Hook-Driven Reflective Article
cultural_format_structure.audience_promise: The reader will start with a concrete odd detail and leave seeing shared maintenance as civic care.
cultural_format_structure.audience_hook: Open on the muddy shoe at the garden gate before naming the article's civic meaning.

parts.label: Concrete Hook
parts.function: Earn immediate curiosity through one visible object that implies an unseen story.

parts.label: Promise
parts.function: Let the reader understand that the piece is about care infrastructure, not a lost-object anecdote.

parts.label: Turn
parts.function: Shift from pleasant garden story to the repeated labor that makes public ease possible.

parts.label: Payoff
parts.function: Return the reader to visible details with changed attention rather than a tidy moral.

cultural_format_structure.turn_or_payoff: The article pays off the opening shoe by teaching the reader to see every small maintenance sign as evidence of shared care.
failure_modes: the hook functions as clickbait rather than an emotional doorway
the article subtype is hidden inside primary_text_form instead of CFS
the section jobs repeat CFS functions without concrete drafting instructions
the ending instructs instead of changing perception

text_form.rationale: The broad article form is sufficient because the hook-driven subtype is carried by the accepted shape and Cultural Format Structure.
avoid: using other as an escape hatch for article variants
forcing a separate subtype enum before rehearsals prove one is needed
turning the article into a generic essay

voice_point_of_view.speaker: a close observer of the garden who respects the caretakers without claiming authority over them
voice_point_of_view.point_of_view: first person plural avoided; limited first person singular allowed only for noticing
voice_point_of_view.distance: near enough to show details, restrained enough to avoid confession
voice_point_of_view.authority: earned by attention to maintenance details rather than expertise claims

structure_plan.structure_rationale: The article needs an argument-shaped movement, but each section must stay anchored to a concrete beat and a distinct reader experience.

sections.section_job: Open with the muddy shoe as a humane disturbance, making the reader want to understand the garden before any thesis appears.
sections.intended_feeling: curious tenderness sharpened by a small disturbance
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The garden article begins with evidence of use and absence instead of seasonal beauty.
source_wording_notes: Use only invented details from this rehearsal.
Do not imply a real person, child, or location.
sections.paragraph_distinction: Image-first and question-making; no abstract civic language yet.

sections.section_job: Reveal the watering rota, latch repair, and quiet coordination so the article's promise becomes visible: care is infrastructure when repeated.
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The expected lost-shoe answer is displaced by the adults who make the garden usable.
source_wording_notes: Avoid reported quotes or named organizations.
sections.paragraph_distinction: Moves from object to system; allows the clearest claim but keeps it grounded in action.

sections.section_job: Return to small signs of maintenance so the reader leaves trained to notice care without being handed a moral or volunteer pitch.
sections.intended_feeling: modest civic attention that lingers after the article
sections.expectation_turn_translation: The article does not solve the shoe or end with gratitude; it changes the reader's noticing practice.
source_wording_notes: Do not invent a resolved owner for the shoe.
sections.paragraph_distinction: Shorter, quieter, and more residue-based than the middle section.

length_policy.rationale: A compact hook-driven article needs enough room for hook, turn, and payoff without becoming a feature.

source_wording_constraints: No real source wording exists; use only safe invented material.
Preserve the invented shoe, watering rota, latch, barrel, and swept path as traceable details.
transformation_allowed: reorder details within the approved section jobs
create new connective prose from the approved meaning
fidelity_policy.rights_notes: Safe invented rehearsal material only; no provider calls and no user-provided private reference.
fidelity_policy.rationale: The rehearsal is testing schema and planning behavior, so fidelity means preserving approved invented meaning and traceable details rather than copying source language.

publication_use.audience: readers of a short reflective article about shared places and maintenance
publication_use.privacy_notes: No real people, places, quotes, or private artist material are represented.
publication_use.rights_notes: Disposable local rehearsal in .tmp; not a publishable factual article.

traceability_summary.note: The Text Medium Plan preserves the invented Artist Meaning: make ordinary maintenance visible as shared care.
The three article sections map one-to-one to the hook, reveal, and payoff beats without requiring section order fields.
The middle section keeps the CFS promise/turn merged while retaining one concrete section job.
